name: ModelDisplay
lead: A model visual in a room. Shares at, rotation, scale, alive and move with other visuals; adds named animations and model materials.

functions.name: move
functions.description: Place and turn it in one step, every part and seat together.

functions.name: play
functions.description: Starts an animation; replaying the current one changes speed without restarting.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Where it is; the parts stay as they are.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Removes the model from the room.

fields.name: id
fields.description: What `player:ride(model)` is handed; the seat is picked from `seats`.

fields.name: paint
fields.description: Whether it is still present. Read-only. Where it stands; live, and each write is a move of its own. Partial writes preserve other angles; nil after removal. Reads vec3; write a number or equal-axis vec3 for uniform size. Nil when gone. Material name to colour; write-only.

title: ModelDisplay type
